coded.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
coded.vl: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
coded.n: Private recruitment agencies need an MLVT licence and a USD 100,000 deposit held in an MLVT account, are inspected and can be warned, suspended or have the licence withdrawn. Prakas 252/2013 makes the agency pay unpaid wages first when the embassy confirms them before repatriation, but no general joint liability with the foreign employer is written.
coded.src: Sub-Decree No. 190 (2011); Prakas on recruitment agencies (2013) · official text: https://mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/អនុក្រឹត្យ-សេចក្ដីសម្រេច/42-អនុក្រឹត្យ-សេចក្ដីសម្រេច/178.html

coded.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
coded.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
coded.vl: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
coded.n: Sub-Decree 190 sets no fee rule. Prakas 046/2013 leaves costs of finding work abroad to separate MLVT guidance for each destination; a 2026 MLVT notice fixes the service fee for farm work in Israel at about USD 3,800 and warns against overcharging. No general prohibition on charging workers was found.
coded.src: Sub-Decree No. 190 (2011); Prakas (2013) · official text: https://mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/កម្រងលិខិតបទដ្ឋានគតិយុត្ត/3732.html

coded.vi: Kontrak tertulis dengan syarat minimum yang ditetapkan atau diverifikasi negara wajib bagi setiap pekerja sebelum berangkat
coded.vl: A written contract with minimum terms set or verified by the state is required for every worker before departure
coded.n: The agency must sign and carry out a contract with the Ministry, a recruitment service contract with the worker and an employment contract between the foreign employer and the worker. The employment contract must state working conditions, wages and benefits, be in Khmer, the destination language and English, and be sent to the Cambodian mission; contract models are set by Prakas and the contract must bear the signature of an MLVT representative. Prakas 253/2013 sets the minimum standard service
coded.src: Sub-Decree No. 190 (2011); Prakas on contracts (2013) · official text: https://mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/អនុក្រឹត្យ-សេចក្ដីសម្រេច/42-អនុក្រឹត្យ-សេចក្ដីសម្រេច/178.html

coded.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
coded.vl: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
coded.n: Pre-departure orientation is compulsory and must follow the MLVT curriculum; it is delivered by the licensed agency in its training centre, and the Ministry issues a certificate that is required before the worker is sent. The texts do not say that orientation is free of charge to the worker.
coded.src: Prakas on pre-departure orientation (2013) · official text: https://mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/កម្រងលិខិតបទដ្ឋានគតិយុត្ត/3732.html

coded.vi: Cakupan terbatas pada sebagian kategori pekerja atau sebagian risiko
coded.vl: Coverage is limited to some categories of workers or to some of these risks
coded.n: There is no statutory welfare fund or compulsory insurance for migrant workers. The agency deposit (USD 100,000) held by the MLVT may be used to repatriate workers in force majeure, war, unrest or epidemics, or when an agency fails to settle disputes; agencies must help workers obtain the destination's social security and bear the repatriation of the body of a worker who dies abroad.
coded.src: Sub-Decree No. 190 (2011) · official text: https://mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/អនុក្រឹត្យ-សេចក្ដីសម្រេច/42-អនុក្រឹត្យ-សេចក្ដីសម្រេច/178.html

coded.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vi: Atase ditempatkan berdasarkan keputusan administratif atau kebijakan, tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Officers are posted by administrative decision or policy, without a statutory duty
coded.n: Labour attachés or officers in charge of workers are posted at embassies and consulates in Thailand, Korea, Malaysia and Japan by government decision. Sub-Decree 190 does not require them, and the 2019–2023 Labour Migration Policy notes that they are not yet in all destination countries.
coded.src: Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training · official guidance: https://mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/គោលនយោបាយ-និងផែនការ/2075.html

coded.vi: Pengaduan menghasilkan sanksi administratif atau pengembalian biaya, tetapi ganti rugi memerlukan pengadilan umum
coded.vl: Complaints lead to administrative sanctions or refunds of fees, but compensation needs the ordinary courts
coded.n: A complaints unit in the MLVT Department of Employment and Manpower and the provincial labour departments receives complaints from migrant workers, including money claims, and conciliates them; agreements are binding, and unresolved cases leave the parties to their legal rights. The agency deposit can be used when an agency fails to settle a dispute, and agencies face warnings, suspension or licence withdrawal; there is no body that awards compensation.
coded.src: Prakas on the complaint mechanism (2013) · official text: https://mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/កម្រងលិខិតបទដ្ឋានគតិយុត្ត/3732.html

coded.fn: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
coded.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
coded.vi: Pembatasan menurut negara tujuan atau jabatan, atau usia minimum di atas 18, yang netral gender secara tertulis
coded.vl: Restrictions by destination or occupation, or minimum ages above 18, that are sex-neutral on their face
coded.n: Migrant workers of both sexes must be at least 18. In September 2026 the MLVT banned advertising, recruiting and sending Khmer migrant workers abroad for fishing and mining work, and it has warned against recruitment for Russia and Armenia; the rules are sex-neutral on their face. Agencies are authorized separately for each destination (some lists concern female domestic workers).
coded.src: Sub-Decree No. 190 (2011); Ministry announcements · official guidance: https://mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/សេចក្ដីជូនដំណឹង-សេចក្ដីណែនាំ/51-សេចក្ដីជូនដំណឹង-សេចក្ដីណែនាំ/3806.html

coded.vi: Reintegrasi bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Reintegration rests on policy or programs without a statutory duty
coded.n: Sub-Decree 190 only requires agencies to bring returning workers to the Ministry for a certificate of work done abroad. Reintegration rests on the Labour Migration Policy and programs: in 2026 the MLVT, with the Cambodian centre for returned migrant workers (HRCC), offers free vocational and entrepreneurship training and job referral through the National Employment Agency to returned workers.
coded.src: Labour Migration Policy · official guidance: https://mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/សេចក្ដីជូនដំណឹង-សេចក្ដីណែនាំ/51-សេចក្ដីជូនដំណឹង-សេចក្ដីណែនាំ/3728.html
